name: phase_g_retrieval_v1
description: Deterministic retrieval benchmark: exact, semantic, paraphrase, metadata, freshness, duplicate, conflict, history queries with doc-level relevance judgments.

documents.text: The model router selects adapters by health checks and capability match. Unhealthy adapters are skipped with automatic fallback to the next candidate. Routing scores combine capability, availability, latency, resources, and history.
The runtime cache expires entries after their TTL seconds elapse. Expired entries are evicted on read and a cleanup pass removes the rest. Cache hits avoid recomputing expensive intelligence results.
The cache TTL policy is fixed at sixty seconds for every entry. Operators must not change the TTL without approval from the platform team.
The cache TTL policy is not fixed and adapts dynamically instead. The previous sixty second rule is superseded by load based adjustment.
Checkpoint records capture task progress for durable recovery. Each checkpoint stores the step payload and a timestamp for ordering.
